items.title: Microsoft Releases Update for Windows 11, version 25H2 and 24H2 Systems
items.description: Microsoft has officially released the optional non-security preview update KB5074105 for Windows 11, versions 25H2 and 24H2. This release, part of the January 2026 “C-week” schedule, focuses on functionality enhancements, performance optimization, and reliability improvements rather than addressing security vulnerabilities. items.title: From Quantum to AI Risks: Preparing for Cybersecurity's Future
items.description: As 2026 begins, these journalists urge the cybersecurity industry to prioritize patching vulnerabilities, preparing for quantum threats, and refining AI applications, in the latest edition of Reporters' Notebook.
